title.zh: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6.2 Astra 与 Sol
title.en: GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol

summary.zh: OpenAI 官网发布介绍页面，推出 GPT-6.2 的两个版本 Astra 与 Sol。该消息在 Hacker News 上引发大量讨论，获逾千点赞、七百余条评论。
summary.en: OpenAI published an index page introducing GPT-6.2 in two variants, Astra and Sol. The announcement drew heavy discussion on Hacker News, with over 1,100 points and more than 700 comments.

reports.title: GPT‑6.2 Astra and Sol

title.zh: 投资者需求强劲，Anthropic拟上调IPO发行价，估值或达1.5万亿至1.6万亿美元
title.en: Strong Investor Demand: Anthropic Plans to Raise IPO Price, Valuation to Reach $1.5–1.6 Trillion

summary.zh: 由于投资者需求强劲，Anthropic计划提高IPO发行价，估值预计达到1.5万亿至1.6万亿美元。此举反映市场对人工智能领军企业的强烈兴趣。
summary.en: Citing strong investor demand, Anthropic plans to raise its IPO price, with a valuation expected between $1.5 trillion and $1.6 trillion. The move highlights intense market interest in leading AI companies.

reports.title: 投资者需求强劲，Anthropic计划上调IPO价格，估值将达1.5-1.6万亿美元 - 华尔街见闻

title.zh: Java4Shell：OpenJDK 处理 Base64 时存在远程代码执行漏洞
title.en: Java4Shell: RCE in OpenJDK when processing Base64

summary.zh: 研究人员披露一个名为“Java4Shell”的漏洞，称 OpenJDK 在解析 Base64 数据时可能触发远程代码执行（RCE）。该发现在 Hacker News 上引发大量讨论，受影响版本范围与修复方案仍待进一步核实。
summary.en: Researchers disclosed a flaw dubbed "Java4Shell" that can trigger remote code execution in OpenJDK when it processes Base64 data. The finding drew heavy discussion on Hacker News, with affected versions and fixes still being assessed.

reports.title: Java4Shell: RCE in OpenJDK when processing Base64

title.zh: Anthropic IPO后，亚马逊与谷歌合计持股将接近30%
title.en: Amazon and Google will together own nearly 30% of Anthropic after its IPO

summary.zh: Anthropic IPO后，亚马逊将持股略低于15%，并有权进一步增持。谷歌以近14%紧随其后。两家合计持股接近30%。
summary.en: After Anthropic's IPO, Amazon will hold just under 15% and may increase its stake. Google will hold nearly 14%, putting their combined ownership close to 30%.

reports.title: Amazon and Google will together own nearly 30% of Anthropic after its IPO

title.zh: 美SEC据报调查英伟达 黄仁勋离职风波持续
title.en: SEC reportedly investigating Nvidia amid Huang exit

summary.zh: 《华尔街日报》报道，美国证券交易委员会正对英伟达展开调查。此前，CEO黄仁勋离职，并承认与一名被指为中国间谍的人存在婚外情。相关指控与调查细节尚待证实。
summary.en: The Wall Street Journal reports that the SEC is investigating Nvidia after CEO Jensen Huang departed. Huang admitted to an affair with a person alleged to be a Chinese spy; the claims and probe details remain unconfirmed.

reports.title: SEC reportedly investigating Nvidia amid Huang exit
Nvidia says it won't reinstate Huang as firm reports bumper results
Nvidia says its open source AI strategy remains intact after Jensen Huang’s exit
Jensen Huang says he’s willing to return as Nvidia CEO

title.zh: 美国失去麻疹消除状态，26年来首次，病例数创纪录
title.en: US loses measles elimination status after 26 years amid record case numbers

summary.zh: 美国各州已报告超过5400例麻疹病例和10例相关死亡，为上世纪90年代初以来首次。疫情持续蔓延，使美国在维持26年后失去麻疹消除状态。
summary.en: States have reported more than 5,400 measles cases and 10 related deaths, the first such deaths since the early 1990s. The outbreak has caused the US to lose its measles elimination status after 26 years.

reports.title: US loses measles elimination status after 26 years amid record case numbers

title.zh: 微软 AI 发布 MAI Code 2 与 MAI Code 2 Flash 代码模型
title.en: MAI Code 2 and Code 2 Flash

summary.zh: 微软 AI 团队发布两款代码模型 MAI Code 2 与 MAI Code 2 Flash，具体能力与基准数据见于其官方公告。该消息在 Hacker News 上获得约 300 点关注与 130 余条讨论。
summary.en: Microsoft AI announced two new coding models, MAI Code 2 and MAI Code 2 Flash, detailed in an official blog post. The launch drew roughly 300 points and over 130 comments on Hacker News.

reports.title: MAI Code 2 and Code 2 Flash
Harvard researchers find AI coding agents shifted the bottleneck to code review

title.zh: 英伟达营收达1040亿美元之际停止披露新加坡销售额
title.en: Nvidia stopped disclosing Singapore sales as revenues hit $104B

summary.zh: 英伟达在营收达到1040亿美元之际，停止披露新加坡销售额。此举使外界难以追踪其新加坡相关销售规模与信息披露变化。
summary.en: Nvidia has stopped disclosing its Singapore sales as revenues reached $104 billion. The change makes it harder to track the scale of sales linked to Singapore and shifts in the company’s disclosure practices.

reports.title: Nvidia stopped disclosing Singapore sales as revenues hit $104B

title.zh: 美国高度机密国家安全通信网络发生中断
title.en: Highly classified US national security communications network goes down

summary.zh: 据路透社报道，美国一套高度机密的国家安全通信网络出现中断。目前受影响范围、持续时间与原因均未公开披露，此事在技术社区引发广泛关注与讨论。
summary.en: A highly classified US national security communications network went down, Reuters reported. The scope, duration and cause of the outage were not immediately disclosed, drawing widespread attention among technology communities.

reports.title: Highly classified US national security communications network goes down
NSA Internal Network Down

title.zh: 新证据显示：校园手机禁令正逐步提升考试成绩
title.en: New Evidence Shows School Phone Bans Are Gradually Improving Test Scores

summary.zh: 《纽约时报》报道称，新的研究证据表明，学校实施手机禁令后，学生考试成绩呈逐步改善趋势。该话题在技术社区引发广泛讨论，涉及教学管理与学生专注力的权衡。
summary.en: New evidence reported by The New York Times suggests that school phone bans are gradually improving students' test scores. The findings add to the debate over classroom technology limits and student focus, drawing wide discussion online.

reports.title: New Evidence Shows School Phone Bans Are Gradually Improving Test Scores

title.zh: Optimizely 遭入侵，向 Zoom、GitLab 等站点投放恶意程序
title.en: Optimizely compromised, served malware on Zoom, GitLab

summary.zh: 据 report-uri 博客披露，网站优化与A/B测试服务商 Optimizely 被入侵，导致其脚本向包括 Zoom、GitLab 在内的多家知名网站访客下发恶意代码。事件属第三方脚本供应链攻击，波及大量全球品牌。
summary.en: Security researchers report that Optimizely, a widely used website testing and personalization service, was compromised and its script delivered malware to visitors of major sites including Zoom and GitLab. The incident is a third-party script supply-chain attack affecting many global brands.

reports.title: Optimizely compromised, served malware on Zoom, GitLab

title.zh: Google AI 回答导致搜索流量下降 40%
title.en: Google's AI answers reducing search traffic by 40%

summary.zh: Revscope 博客称，Google 的 AI 回答使搜索流量减少 40%，该说法在 Hacker News 引发讨论（133 分、89 条评论）。原文未提供更多细节，结论仍需核实。
summary.en: A Revscope blog post claims Google's AI answers are cutting search traffic by 40%, sparking discussion on Hacker News (133 points, 89 comments). The excerpt provides no further evidence, so the claim remains unverified.

reports.title: Google's AI answers reducing search traffic by 40%

title.zh: Quad9 退出法国：矿井里的金丝雀
title.en: Quad9's withdrawal from France: A canary in the coal mine

summary.zh: Cloudflare 博客评述 Quad9 因法国域名封锁要求而退出该国，认为这是 DNS 中立性与互联网审查蔓延的预警信号，在技术社区引发广泛讨论。
summary.en: A Cloudflare blog post examines Quad9's withdrawal from France after it was pressed to block domains, framing the move as an early warning about DNS neutrality and the spread of internet censorship. The topic drew heavy discussion on Hacker News.

reports.title: Quad9's withdrawal from France: A canary in the coal mine

title.zh: 谷歌Spark AI代理更名为“Tasks”并免费开放
title.en: Google’s Spark AI agent becomes ‘Tasks’ — and now it’s free

summary.zh: 谷歌将Spark AI代理更名为“Tasks”并免费提供。该功能由Gemini 4 Hydrogen模型驱动，可制定膳食计划、管理日历，并从邮件中查找可削减的经常性支出。美国用户已可使用。
summary.en: Google is rebranding its Spark AI agent as “Tasks” and making it free. Powered by the Gemini 4 Hydrogen model, it can create meal plans, manage calendars, and find recurring expenses in emails. US users can access it.

reports.title: Google’s Spark AI agent becomes ‘Tasks’ — and now it’s free
Google expands access to Gemini Tasks, which can help with calls, purchases

title.zh: 苹果服务中断
title.en: Apple Services Down

summary.zh: 苹果系统状态页面显示出现服务中断，相关讨论在技术社区引发关注。原文未具体说明受影响的服务范围及原因。
summary.en: Apple's system status page indicates service outages, drawing attention in a tech community discussion. The source does not specify which services are affected or the cause.

reports.title: Apple Services Down

title.zh: 共享账号网站 BugMeNot 宣布关闭
title.en: BugMeNot has closed

summary.zh: 曾用于绕过网站注册墙的共享登录凭据服务 BugMeNot 已停止运营，其官网目前仅显示关闭提示。该站点长期提供用户提交的公共账号密码，供他人跳过强制注册，关闭消息在技术社区引发大量讨论。
summary.en: BugMeNot, the long-running service that shared user-submitted logins so people could bypass mandatory website registration, has shut down. Its site now displays only a closure notice, and the news drew heavy discussion in tech communities.

reports.title: BugMeNot has closed

title.zh: 摩根大通正研发无需人工参与的AI代理交易
title.en: JPMorgan is working on AI agent transactions that don’t involve humans

summary.zh: 摩根大通与现代信用卡寻求扩大AI代理在金融交易中的应用，相关交易可能无需人工介入。此举显示金融机构正推进AI代理自主完成支付与交易流程。
summary.en: JPMorgan and Hyundai Card are seeking to expand the use of AI agents in financial transactions, with JPMorgan working on transactions that do not involve humans. The move points to growing bank interest in autonomous AI-driven payment and transaction processes.

reports.title: JPMorgan is working on AI agent transactions that don’t involve humans

title.zh: 游戏界的“登月”：澳大利亚玩家准备率先涌入罪恶都市体验《GTA VI》
title.en: The ‘moon landing’ of gaming: Australians, some of the first to play GTA VI, prepare to descend on Vice City

summary.zh: 历经13年等待，《侠盗猎车手VI》即将于周四发售，澳大利亚玩家正准备迎接这一世代级游戏盛事。支持者认为，其热度将超过大型体育赛事。
summary.en: After a 13-year wait, Grand Theft Auto VI is set to launch on Thursday, with Australian gamers preparing for what fans call a generation-defining event. Supporters say its scale could surpass major sporting events.

reports.title: The ‘moon landing’ of gaming: Australians, some of the first to play GTA VI, prepare to descend on Vice City

title.zh: 韩国加强高考防AI作弊：检查袖子、禁智能眼镜
title.en: Sleeve checks and no smartglasses: South Korea races to protect all-important university exams against AI

summary.zh: 韩国在逾50万学生参加高考前夕曝出AI辅助作弊事件，一名专业考试最高分者承认用隐藏摄像头和AI作弊。当局在1312个考点加强安检，检查袖子并禁止智能眼镜，以维护考试公正。
summary.en: South Korea is tightening security for its high-stakes university entrance exam after a top professional exam scorer admitted using a hidden camera and AI to cheat. More than 500,000 students will sit the exam at 1,312 centres, with sleeve checks and smartglasses bans.

reports.title: Sleeve checks and no smartglasses: South Korea races to protect all-important university exams against AI

title.zh: 调查：巴西去年1605起中毒报告涉欧洲产农药
title.en: European-made pesticides named in 1,605 poisoning reports in Brazil last year

summary.zh: 巴西去年1605起中毒报告涉及欧洲化工企业销售的农药，约三分之一牵涉因危害健康和环境而在欧盟农场被禁用的化学品；欧盟仅禁用其农业使用，未禁止企业生产。
summary.en: An investigation found that pesticides sold by European chemical companies were named in more than 1,600 poisoning reports in Brazil last year. About a third involved chemicals banned on EU farms due to risks to people and the environment, though EU companies may still manufacture them.

reports.title: European-made pesticides named in 1,605 poisoning reports in Brazil last year

title.zh: 詹姆斯起诉AI体育博彩初创公司 指其AI广告侵犯肖像权
title.en: LeBron James sues startup over viral AI ad allegedly exploiting his likeness

summary.zh: 勒布朗·詹姆斯起诉一家AI体育博彩初创公司，指控其未经授权利用他的肖像制作并传播病毒式广告。案件凸显AI生成内容与名人肖像权之间的法律争议。
summary.en: LeBron James sued an AI-powered sports betting startup, alleging it used his likeness without authorization in a viral advertisement. The case highlights legal tensions over AI-generated content and celebrity publicity rights.

reports.title: LeBron James sues startup over viral AI ad allegedly exploiting his likeness

title.zh: 倪润峰与中国彩电业的共同成长｜纪念
title.en: Ni Runfeng and the Growth of China's Color TV Industry | In Memoriam

summary.zh: 财新刊发纪念文章，回顾倪润峰与中国彩电业共同成长的历程。文章以其个人经历折射行业变迁。
summary.en: Caixin publishes a memorial piece reviewing how Ni Runfeng's career paralleled the growth of China's color television industry. It reflects on his experience amid the sector's development.

reports.title: 倪润峰与中国彩电业的共同成长｜纪念 - 财新

title.zh: 巴西亚马逊孤立部落现身，外界担忧其生活方式受威胁
title.en: Isolated Brazilian tribe emerges amid alarm over threats to group’s way of life

summary.zh: 巴西亚马逊雨林约20名自愿隔离的Awá人周一进入村庄，并与政府团队接触，被相关组织称为“历史性接触”。Survival International警告，部落领地遭入侵加剧，引发对其生活方式的担忧。
summary.en: About 20 members of Brazil’s voluntarily isolated Awá people emerged from the Amazon rainforest on Monday, contacting a village and a government team in what Survival International called a historic encounter. The NGO warned that increased invasions of the tribe’s territory threaten its way of life.

reports.title: Isolated Brazilian tribe emerges amid alarm over threats to group’s way of life

title.zh: 俄罗斯军用飞机坠毁，机上19人全部遇难
title.en: Russian military plane crashes, killing all 19 on board

summary.zh: 俄罗斯国防部称，一架军用飞机在克麦罗沃地区坠毁，机上19人全部遇难。初步判断原因为技术故障。
summary.en: A Russian military plane crashed in the Kemerovo region, killing all 19 people on board, according to the defence ministry. Preliminary findings point to a technical malfunction as the cause.

reports.title: Russian military plane crashes, killing all 19 on board

title.zh: 威廉与凯特在孟买出席Earthshot奖颁奖礼
title.en: William and Kate celebrate Earthshot Prize winners in Mumbai

summary.zh: 威尔士亲王与王妃在孟买出席年度Earthshot环保奖颁奖典礼，体育和演艺界明星同场助阵。活动旨在表彰环保创新者。
summary.en: The Prince and Princess of Wales attended the annual Earthshot Prize environmental awards ceremony in Mumbai. Sports and acting stars joined them to celebrate the winners.

reports.title: William and Kate celebrate Earthshot Prize winners in Mumbai

title.zh: 印度孕妇2002年遭轮奸案：两名罪犯获保释，受害者称心碎
title.en: Indian woman gang-raped while pregnant in 2002 'heartbroken' after two perpetrators bailed

summary.zh: 比勒基斯·巴诺对最高法院相关命令表示“痛苦、震惊和难以置信”，誓言继续抗争。她在2002年怀孕期间遭轮奸，近日两名涉案罪犯获保释。
summary.en: Bilkis Bano said she felt “pain, shock and disbelief” after India’s top court order led to two men convicted in her 2002 gang rape being released on bail. She vowed to keep fighting.

reports.title: Indian woman gang-raped while pregnant in 2002 'heartbroken' after two perpetrators bailed

title.zh: 美联航称导致航班延误的技术故障已解决
title.en: United Airlines says technology outage that delayed departures has been resolved - Reuters

summary.zh: 美国联合航空表示，此前导致航班延误的技术故障已恢复。公司未说明故障原因及受影响范围。
summary.en: United Airlines said the technology outage that caused departure delays has been resolved. The carrier did not provide further details on the cause or scope.

reports.title: United Airlines says technology outage that delayed departures has been resolved - Reuters

title.zh: AI行业里，被高薪叙事平均掉的人
title.en: The People Left Out by the AI Industry's High-Salary Narrative

summary.zh: 界面新闻关注AI行业高薪叙事下被“平均”掉的从业者，讨论薪酬光环之外的人群处境与个体差异。
summary.en: Jiemian.com examines workers in the AI industry who are overlooked or averaged out by the high-salary narrative, highlighting individual situations beyond the industry’s pay spotlight.

reports.title: AI行业里，被高薪叙事平均掉的人 - Jiemian.com

title.zh: 工地监管不再只靠人盯，隧道股份600多个工地项目已实现智能体介入，赋能住建产业精细化管控
title.en: Site Supervision Moves Beyond Manual Watch: STEC Deploys AI Agents at 600-Plus Projects to Enable Fine-Grained Construction Management

summary.zh: 隧道股份已在600多个工地项目引入智能体参与监管，改变以往依靠人工盯守的模式。此举旨在推动住建产业实现精细化、智能化管控。
summary.en: Shanghai Tunnel Engineering Co. (STEC) has deployed AI agents at more than 600 construction projects, shifting site supervision away from reliance on manual monitoring. The move aims to enable finer-grained, more intelligent management across the housing and construction industry.

reports.title: 工地监管不再只靠人盯 隧道股份600多个工地项目已实现智能体介入 赋能住建产业精细化管控 - 第一财经

title.zh: 休·杰克曼、瑞贝尔·威尔逊等150余名澳艺术家呼吁阻止Woodside天然气开发
title.en: Hugh Jackman, Rebel Wilson and 150 Australian artists join call to block Woodside gas development near Scott Reef

summary.zh: 休·杰克曼、瑞贝尔·威尔逊等150多名澳大利亚艺术家签署公开信，敦促部长默里·瓦特拒绝Woodside在金伯利海岸外Browse盆地、斯科特礁附近钻探天然气的计划。该行动由绿色和平组织牵头，旨在阻止这一化石燃料项目。
summary.en: More than 150 Australian artists, including Hugh Jackman and Rebel Wilson, have signed an open letter urging minister Murray Watt to reject Woodside Energy’s plan to drill for gas in the Browse basin near Scott Reef off the Kimberley coast. The Greenpeace-led campaign opposes the fossil fuel project.

reports.title: Hugh Jackman, Rebel Wilson and 150 Australian artists join call to block Woodside gas development near Scott Reef

title.zh: 托马斯·马克尔因菲律宾儿童性虐待材料指控被起诉
title.en: Thomas Markle charged over child sex abuse material in Philippines

summary.zh: 托马斯·马克尔因一项与菲律宾儿童性虐待材料有关的指控被起诉，目前在美国被羁押。他此前否认所有相关指控。
summary.en: Thomas Markle has been charged in connection with child sex abuse material in the Philippines and is being held in custody in the US. He has previously denied all allegations.

reports.title: Thomas Markle charged over child sex abuse material in Philippines

title.zh: 伍兹将于12月英雄世界挑战赛复出参赛
title.en: Woods to make competitive return at December's Hero World Challenge - Reuters

summary.zh: 路透社报道，泰格·伍兹将在12月的英雄世界挑战赛上重返赛场。这将是伍兹在经历伤病休整后的又一次复出。
summary.en: Tiger Woods will return to competitive golf at December’s Hero World Challenge, Reuters reported. The event marks another comeback for Woods after recent injury layoffs.

reports.title: Woods to make competitive return at December's Hero World Challenge - Reuters

title.zh: LIV联赛崩溃后，德尚博将加入DP世界巡回赛
title.en: DeChambeau to join DP World Tour after LIV collapse - Reuters

summary.zh: 路透社报道，在LIV高尔夫联赛崩溃后，布赖森·德尚博将加入DP世界巡回赛。此举可能影响职业高尔夫赛事格局。
summary.en: Reuters reports that Bryson DeChambeau will join the DP World Tour after the collapse of LIV Golf. The move could reshape the professional golf landscape.

reports.title: DeChambeau to join DP World Tour after LIV collapse - Reuters

title.zh: 华侨银行洪湧翔：银行要为出海企业搭建“桥梁”
title.en: OCBC's Hong Yongxiang: Banks Should Build "Bridges" for Companies Going Global

summary.zh: 华侨银行洪湧翔表示，银行应为拓展海外市场的中国企业搭建“桥梁”，在跨境经营中提供金融支持与服务对接。
summary.en: OCBC's Hong Yongxiang said banks should act as "bridges" for Chinese companies expanding overseas, providing cross-border financial support and services as firms pursue global growth.

reports.title: 华侨银行洪湧翔：银行要为出海企业搭建“桥梁” - 财新

title.zh: 399元，只有50ml，孙俪的精油生意有点冷
title.en: 399 yuan for only 50ml: Sun Li's essential oil business feels a chill

summary.zh: 孙俪相关精油产品定价399元、容量仅50ml，市场反响偏冷，引发对其明星副业定价与销量的关注。
summary.en: A Sun Li-linked essential oil product priced at 399 yuan for only 50ml is seeing a weak market response, drawing attention to the pricing and sales of celebrity side businesses.

reports.title: 399元，只有50ml，孙俪的精油生意有点冷 - Jiemian.com

title.zh: “必须追责”：墨尔本杯赛马遗体被弃垃圾箱，马主吁彻查
title.en: ‘Heads should roll’: owner of Melbourne Cup horse found dumped in skip bin demands investigation

summary.zh: 墨尔本杯参赛马“So You Are”的尸体在悉尼一处垃圾场的垃圾箱内被发现。其所有者兼育种者Stuart Ramsey称这是“奇耻大辱”，要求全面调查并追究责任。
summary.en: The body of Melbourne Cup runner So You Are was found in a skip bin at a Sydney tip. Owner-breeder Stuart Ramsey called it a 'bloody disgrace' and demanded a full investigation, saying 'heads have got to roll'.

reports.title: ‘Heads should roll’: owner of Melbourne Cup horse found dumped in skip bin demands investigation

title.zh: 黄仁勋的离开将给英伟达带来持久损害
title.en: Jensen Huang’s departure will cause lasting damage to Nvidia

summary.zh: 文章指出，黄仁勋的离开将给英伟达造成持久损害，而完整代价会随时间才逐渐显现。它值得读，因为创始人CEO的变动会深刻影响芯片巨头的战略、创新与市场信心，短期财报难以反映。读者可借此理解领导层与公司护城河之间的关系。
summary.en: The article argues that Jensen Huang’s departure would cause lasting damage to Nvidia, with the full toll becoming clear only over time. It is worth reading because leadership change at a chip giant can affect strategy, innovation and market confidence in ways quarterly results cannot capture. The piece offers a lens on how founder-CEOs shape corporate moats.

title.zh: 无穷小是微积分不可或缺的，但它们真的存在吗？
title.en: Infinitesimals are essential to calculus. But are they even real?

summary.zh: 文章从微积分创立对无穷小的依赖谈起，梳理数学家对其合法性的长期质疑，并讨论无穷小究竟只是便利的计算工具，还是可被严格定义的真实数学对象。对于想理解微积分基础、数学实在论与形式化方法之争的读者，这篇文章提供了清晰的历史与哲学线索。
summary.en: The article examines calculus’s historical reliance on infinitesimals and the long-standing doubts many mathematicians have raised about their validity. It asks whether infinitesimals are merely useful fictions or legitimate mathematical objects that can be rigorously defined. Readers interested in the foundations of calculus and the philosophy of mathematics will find the debate worth exploring.

title.zh: 为何初创企业终将上市
title.en: Why startups still go public, eventually

summary.zh: 文章讨论监管成本是否阻碍IPO，并指出高昂合规负担并非初创企业上市的主要威慑。尽管上市代价不低，企业仍会因融资、流动性与治理等长期收益而走向公开市场。文章有助于厘清“监管扼杀IPO”的直觉，理解企业上市时机与制度成本之间的真实关系。
summary.en: This article examines whether costly regulation deters IPOs and argues that high compliance burdens are not a major obstacle for startups. Despite the expense, firms still eventually go public for long-term benefits such as capital access, liquidity and governance. It is worth reading for a clearer view of how regulation shapes—but does not determine—IPO timing and decisions.

title.zh: 美国正式失去麻疹消除地位，公共卫生遭受重击
title.en: U.S. officially loses measles elimination status in a body blow to public health

summary.zh: 美国正式失去麻疹消除地位，这一决定发生在全国麻疹疫情广泛暴发之际。消除地位被撤销不仅标志公共卫生受挫，也反映疫苗接种与防控体系面临的压力。文章有助于理解疫情蔓延的后果及美国公共卫生应对的警示意义，值得深入阅读。
summary.en: The U.S. has officially lost its measles elimination status amid a widespread national outbreak. The decision marks a significant setback for public health and raises questions about vaccination coverage and outbreak response. Reading it helps clarify what elimination status means and why its loss matters.

title.zh: “他们说的都毫无道理”：随英国“主权公民”深入兔子洞
title.en: ‘Nothing they said made sense’: down the rabbit hole with Britain’s sovereign citizens

summary.zh: 本文追溯“主权公民”这一源自美国、蔓延全球的反政府意识形态，讲述英国汉普郡一次金融监管突袭如何牵出当事人的离奇信念，并剖析其耗费公共资源、破坏生活的代价。文章不仅呈现个体故事，也追问这些极端观念为何具有吸引力。适合想理解阴谋论、法律边缘主义与监管困境的读者深入阅读。
summary.en: This long read traces the “sovereign citizen” movement, an anti-government ideology that began in the US and has spread worldwide, wasting public resources and damaging lives. Starting with a Financial Conduct Authority raid on a rural Hampshire home, it explores how fringe legal beliefs take hold and why they appeal. It is worth reading for its close look at conspiracy, regulation and the costs of pseudo-legal resistance.
